messages:
sasha: FYI scheduling a slim rebuild of inference-runtime base image Wed 09:00 PT. Objectives: patch CVE-2026-1234, tighten seccomp, drop /sbin tools, add immutable rootfs marker. Need RBAC & KMS signer plan.

maria: Sounds good. Can we get a short preflight checklist and decision on cosign key rotation?

jonathan: If we change signature envelope (adding COSE metadata) we should rotate. KMS key versioning makes rotation straightforward; ensure audit logs for sign ops go to sec-observe for 90d.

ops-oncall: Any traffic windows? We have a 50-pod canary pool; recommend 1h canary then ramp. I'll reserve 09:00-11:00 PT.

sasha: Proposed flow: 1) SBOM + vuln scan 2) build & sign in staging with current KMS key 3) deploy canary 1h 4) rotate key + re-sign for prod 5) full rollout. If rotation causes issues we can postpone.

maria: Who owns the signer IAM? Current binding: project:ci-sa -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. For signing we need cloudkms.asymmetricSign + getPublicKey. Suggest ephemeral binding via iam-proxy TTL=1h.

jonathan: Agreed. Add registry write (artifact-writer) for cosign annotations on the ephemeral token. Also ensure verifier accepts both old/new keys during transition. Include key id in signature envelope.

ops-oncall: I'll add a rollback rule: if canary error-rate >2% for 10m, auto-revert to previous tag and re-pin verifier to previous pubkey. Keep last 3 tags.

sasha: Maria, please draft minimal IAM policy for "image-signer" role: resource limited to the cosign key and permissions [cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.getPublicKey, cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.asymmetricSign]. Condition: limited to token TTL.

maria: Drafted checklist: - syft sbom + grype scan (fail on high) - reproducible build flags - container-scan smoke - push staging image + sign - verify attestations - confirm KMS audit sink logs sign events. Dev commands: ```bash
syft packages:docker -o json -q -t sbom.json
grype sbom:sbom.json --fail-on high
COSIGN_EXPERIMENTAL=1 cosign sign --key k8s://projects/infra/locations/global/keyRings/rebuild/cryptoKeys/cosign-key gcr.io/redwood/inference-runtime:staging
```

deploy-bot: [build-system] staging build done: gcr.io/redwood/inference-runtime:staging-4890001111 -> signed (cosign-key v2).

maria: verification passed locally, pushing canary.

ops-oncall: Canary deployed (50 pods). +12m metrics stable. :thumbsup: 

jonathan: Confirmed signBlob entries in KMS audit sink; forwarding to sec-observe, retention 90d. Also added trace tag "image-rebuild:4890001111" to deploys.

sasha: Post-rollout action: run grype diff against previous prod to detect regressions from pruning. Maria to add to post-rollout checklist.

maria: Will run grype diff and publish results. Also will ensure attest-store indexes both signing keys during rotation.

sasha: Owners: Sasha=orchestration, Maria=CI signing+IAM, Jonathan=audit+verifier, Ops-oncall=schedule+rollback. Ping #eng-oncall and tag me if any issues. I'll post final prod cutover notes after green. :white_check_mark:
